summary: Restoration and conservation form the core: the NDC calls for reforesting 4,500 km² of degraded forest in protected areas by 2030, equivalent to about 18.4% of current forest cover, and increasing removals by 1.35 MtCO₂/year, alongside a 15,000 ha/year reforestation rate. It seeks effective conservation of 30% of national territory (about 14,488 km²), zero net mangrove loss by 2030, and protection/restoration of 80% of priority coastal-marine areas by 2030 and 100% by 2035, while conservation/restoration/sustainable management of priority ecosystems rises from 50% by 2030 to 70% by 2035. Agriculture targets include 20% and 30% variants for sustainable management of national agricultural area, 50% biodigestion/composting treatment, lower cattle mortality, and low-carbon coffee, cocoa and rice areas of 75,102 ha, 146,648 ha and 30,000 ha. These commodity areas equal about 5.3%, 10.3% and 2.1% of current mapped agriculture, respectively.
